quote: You can prospect these but they seem to always give an ambivalent amber.
notes: Original firsthand comment identifies Handful of Pebbles (213398) as a prospectable input yielding Ambivalent Amber (212498). Another commenter Tristful independently repeats this mapping on the Amber item page https://www.wowhead.com/item=212498/ambivalent-amber. 'Always' is anecdotal and not a measured probability: casts, observed hits, zeros, input batch size, gem-stack units, skill and unlock, data date, and game build all unknown. No 100% chance is inferred. Reference only and not estimator-eligible.

Independent item-identity reference explicitly lists Handful of Pebbles as one of the Algari Prospecting inputs that can yield Ostentatious Onyx. Exact outputItemID not recovered from this source, so it remains null. Wowhead Onyx trait https://www.wowhead.com/profession-trait/onyx-98661 describes chance of Onyx in place of Amber increasing with trait points; precise unlock/spec required for this particular Pebbles input and game build not established. Coexistence with firsthand Amber anecdote is not evidence for separate measured outcomes, a probability, or any hit denominator. Reference only.
